fact: Proclamation No. 1321/2024, signed 24 July 2024 and in force on publication in the Negarit Gazette (art. 70), sets conditions for sending personal data abroad in arts. 18 to 22 and offences for unlawful transfer.
title: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024
publisher: Federal Negarit Gazette of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
